Printer settings & cutting

Match the selected paper size and use portrait orientation. Set 100% / actual size, background graphics on, and headers and footers off. Save a PDF through your browser’s print dialog.

Print an alignment test first. Hold it against a light, then adjust the backs if needed. For manual duplex, test the feed direction and stack order before printing separate front and back jobs.

Cut along the crop marks. Use opaque stock, or identical opaque sleeves and backing cards. The final sheet’s empty positions are mirrored on the back. Crop marks need a printable area within 4 mm of the Letter paper edge.

Tokens are a separate, single-sided print job. White is the fifth suit in all artwork sets.

MPC: unzip the download, then upload the numbered PNGs to Custom Game Cards (63 × 88 mm). The ZIP includes instructions and card quantities.
